grounding.excerpt: *10     The limits begin on the effective date of this permit and lasting through 3 years from the permit effective date.
*11     The limits apply during the period beginning 3 year from the permit effective date
This permit shall become effective on December 1, 2021. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, November 30, 2026.

rationale: The packet establishes two staged TDS net-increase limit regimes tied to permit effective date (December 1, 2021): footnote *10 governs from effective date through three years thereafter (27,664 lbs/day), and footnote *11 governs from three years after effective date (24,992 lbs/day). Federal FY2025 runs 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30, so its monthly monitoring periods straddle the three-year transition on December 1, 2024. October and November 2024 fall under the *10 window; December 2024 through September 2025 fall under the *11 window. The obligation asks which single numeric limit regime governs FY2025 monthly periods, but the evidence does not establish one regime for the entire period_universe—only month-dependent applicability. ACCEPT would require a grounded regime-interval pairing for the stated universe, which is not established. REJECT would require establishing that no such pairing holds, but the packet clearly shows limits apply during portions of FY2025. Neither adjudication burden is met; UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
